entries.dictionary: デジタル大辞泉; 精選版 日本国語大辞典
entries.heading: あ・てる【当てる／充てる／宛てる】; あ・てる【当・中・充・宛】
entries.evidence: Simplified web_fetch returned the full relevant Nikkoku family but omitted Daijisen's definition. An exact raw-HTML curl retrieval returned the Daijisen heading at line1356 and full definition at1359. Sense3c explicitly marks 充てる for using part of a whole for a purpose, with leisure-to-reading and bonus-to-travel-expenses examples. Other senses include contact, guessing, work assignment and addressing correspondence. Nikkoku's section二 likewise covers purpose/use and assignments.
entries.decision: Use the exact frozen standalone 充てるあてる family1334270 and explicit Daijisen spelling-local sense together. Proposed ordinary constructions are resourceを + purposeに + 充てる, with kana and English. Compare existing 当てる's contact/guessing teaching, without falsely claiming that the broad あてる family never overlaps allocation. Distinguish allocation from saving a resource untouched.

The exact unrestricted frozen family1205190 givesかくじゅう and transitive noun/suru expansion.
entries.decision: Reuse the complete existing 拡充 article and its actual primary reading/sense; add only 充's substantive component link. Frozen 拡カク/充ジュウ records support allocation. No new on-support article or invented quantitative frequency claim is necessary.
